_comment: The Cloudflare Worker proxy. Yahoo sends no CORS header, so a browser cannot read its chart API directly - this worker fetches it server-side and adds the header, which is what lets the terminal draw live intraday candles. Leave proxy empty and the site still works: stock pages fall back to the stored daily series.
_telegram_comment: Public Telegram channels read through t.me/s/<name> - no bot token, no login. Tested 17 Nov 2026 on a GitHub runner: these four posted that day and have the web preview enabled. Excluded on evidence, not preference: powerofstocks last posted 15 Jul 2026 and stockmarketupdates last posted in 2016, so collecting them every run buys nothing. abhishekkar and nseindia return NO PREVIEW - the owner has not enabled 'Show a preview of posts on the web', and there is no way around that from outside.
